title: Quaint Flaky Jamaican Rice Fried Rice
description: A herbal and flaky Jamaican dish featuring candied peel, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is perfect for midnight cravings. It combines fry-grind-rice-khao-khua for a unique flavor.
instructions: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add diced scotch bonnet pepper, if using, and saute for 1 minute.
Add chopped scallions and cook until they start to soften.
Add thyme, allspice, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add cooked rice to the skillet, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Stir-fry the rice mixture for about 5 minutes, until it is heated through and starting to brown.
Add diced candied peel to the skillet and stir-fry for another minute.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve the Quaint Flaky Jamaican Rice Fried Rice hot, garnished with additional scallions if desired.
